evaluation_unit: specified function/transformation site; no whole-module absence verdict
split: new named control programs; exploratory unknown-parent corpus samples separately
baseline: presence of br_table / call_indirect / nop / XOR is candidate only

criteria.flattening: trace selector definition, state writes, return to dispatcher, and correspondence to original; state machine alone insufficient
criteria.instrumentation: increment target, read/reset interface, paired original and public implementation correspondence
criteria.call_indirection: match original direct target to transformed constant/table entry; ordinary function pointers are alternative
criteria.renaming: changed names with decoded bodies and operands compared, separating LEB reencoding
criteria.memory: trace replacement helpers and effective key values, do not equate XOR with encryption
criteria.redundancy: local operand semantics; no inference of author intent or global equivalence

validation: mechanical checks on known pilot pairs first; independent human review remains pending
limits: no population prevalence or classifier accuracy without independent reference labels
